title: Enumeration conjecture for k-triangulations on the half-cylinder
statement: Let $T$ be a $k$-triangulation on the half-cylinder $\mathcal{C}_n$. Define a **$k$-star** as the corresponding local configuration of $k+1$ mutually crossing edges, and a **$k$-relevant edge** as an edge participating in the relevant crossing structure. **Enumeration conjecture.** Any $k$-triangulation on $\mathcal{C}_n$ contains exactly $n-1$ $k$-stars, $k(n-1)$ $k$-relevant edges, and $k(2n-1)$ total edges. The formulas agree with the established $k=2$ counts and are suggested by the conditional bijection with periodic $k$-triangulations.
